title: Improve conditional κ with a mixed fourth staged entry (+7.886e-9)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

A fourth staged entry need not be used in every call. Staging helper 601 in exactly 1,080 of the 3,240 T360 calls gives a complete integer owner fill whose paid moment improves #4085. The remaining 2,160 calls use the exact #4085 three-entry words. Both orientations include its receiver-sharing rewrite.

The certified complete moment root is

```
[0.001730978305075885693430,
 0.001730978305075885693431].
```

Under the retained transfer hypotheses and padding convention, the conditional endpoint is `κ = 0.001730978305075885693430 − 10^-46 − 10^-70`. It exceeds #4085's certified upper endpoint by more than `7.885876721990690 × 10^-9`.

**Status: author-checked finite construction, exact phase/operator argument, and conditional moment improvement.** The uniform native realization, common-cover/hosting, analytic, precision, tape, recovery and BIT transfer hypotheses remain inherited. The full ordinary/outer release engine has **not** been rerun with the four-provider mixed dispatch. No selected-frontier change, independent human acceptance or formal-kernel verification is claimed.

The new local variant has profile `{1:2489,2:713,3:227,4:99,5:20,8:8}`; its change from #4085 is `2 H1 + 3 H3 − 3 H4`. Its hosted width for helper 601 drops from 8 to 7. A literal fill accounts for all 1,321,920 roles and 725,760 bins, including every residual term. The complete paid profile is

```
{1:8060040, 2:2310120, 3:751785, 4:327240, 5:66425,
 8:25920, 16:1, 32:2, 48:138490}.
```

Its total paid rank mass remains `65088*360`. The finite selector is `t mod 3 == 0`; the claim does not depend on a fractional packing objective or an optimality claim.

[Construction and replay](https://github.com/1337isnot1337/integer-mult-bounds/blob/76088d49e3ed4142a958659aa996b0ca4da5e88e/research/staged544-mixed-fourth-entry/README.md) · [Proof and scope](https://github.com/1337isnot1337/integer-mult-bounds/blob/76088d49e3ed4142a958659aa996b0ca4da5e88e/research/staged544-mixed-fourth-entry/PROOF.md).

## Task and overlap

- Canonical base: `bb4bccbf42844d2801487450727c2f63e10d1d0f`; task `complex-new-helper-inventory`.
- Immediate source #4085: `c5854c77620723aae6914c32122870519a6f820d`.
- Three-entry predecessor #4076: `9744f9df268590295a9872b1952c695a678192b9`; terminal-width-five predecessor #3945: `91f81d131252db704f945891da1ea54e29d46b8b`.
- Scope is refined to a nonuniform four-provider schedule. #4076's uniform fourth-entry rejection leaves this mixed supply balance open. #4085 supplies the receiver-sharing improvement; the additional contribution here is the fourth-entry composition, selector, literal owner fill and complete price certificate.
- #4087 independently audits the earlier three-entry defect and cleanup. It does not supply this fourth-entry frame/owner construction or the composition with #4085. Latest overlap refresh also read #4086; its six-bank cost floor does not change this supplier.

`EXPORTED-SOURCES.json` pins 55 byte-identical predecessor exports by original PR, commit, path and SHA256; each was compared directly with its Git source. The package carries its runtime source closure. The source-history check covers the canonical pins declared in `SOURCES.json`; it does not claim pending predecessor heads are ancestors.

## Validation

Tested head: `76088d49e3ed4142a958659aa996b0ca4da5e88e`, CPython 3.12.14.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/staged544-mixed-fourth-entry
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/staged544-mixed-fourth-entry --check-source-history
```

Both pass. The official package export and integrity check also pass for all 85 committed files.

- All four exact words pass 723-input forward, dual, reverse-pullback and cleanup-boundary checks, including all 91 arbitrary dirty buffers, plus an independent binary-frame ledger.
- Both new four-entry orientations pass fresh native transport, ledgers, local replay, wrappers and exact phase recipes. Three-entry native receipts are source-pinned imports from #4085. Commands to rerun the fresh native checks are in the README; those checks additionally require NumPy.
- Every owner role, bin, selected helper width, family, offset and capacity is checked. The separate exact phase audit checks strict scalar-observation windows, productive-data nonaliasing, and disjoint slices of the original phase axes with their exact residual complements. No axes move between child slots.
- The inherited Z4 normalizer checks 10,416 symbolic identities across all 112 ports and the complete signed controller, with the all-character and positive-tensor-multiplicity argument retained explicitly.
- Rational enclosures certify both the new root and #4085's bracket. Controls reject omitted/flipped releases, old entrances, wrong sources, owner violations, omitted fourth providers, changed global phases/controllers, unpaid cost and unsupported endpoints. The word checks also pass under `-O`.

Hosted CI is separate and was not claimed successful at submission. The full ordinary/outer release integration remains open.

## Open next questions

1. Extend the pinned ordinary/outer provider registry to the four providers and mixed dispatch, preserve every admission predicate and mutation control, and rerun the complete release. This is the next integration obligation.
2. Improve the selector or integer packing. The periodic one-third schedule is sufficient, not proved optimal; every further gain must again produce a complete literal fill and pass the word, native, phase/operator and price checks.
